other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale in the case of an offence committed by a person in a street parking place reserved for disabled persons' vehicles where that person would not have been guilty of that offence if that motor vehicle in respect of which it was committed had been a disabled person's vehicle.

A fine not exceeding level two on the standard scale in any other case.

Fixed penalty ticket - thirty pounds issued by Local Authority NOT the Police.

Time limit for prosecutions
6 months
